findings.title: Maintainer-only writer path untested
findings.problem: The writer predicate is `isAdmin || isMaintainer` (ProjectModal.tsx:86), but every Maintainer test case (M2 at line 549, the S1 Maintainer row) sets isAdmin: true as well. A user with isAdmin false and isMaintainer true is never exercised for render or submit.
findings.impact: Narrowing the predicate to `isAdmin` would pass the whole suite while locking real Maintainers out of a setting the backend lets them write (is_admin_or_maintainer). The claimed role x surface matrix cell for Maintainer is not actually covered.
findings.recommendation: Add a maintainer-only case (isAdmin false, isMaintainer true, no applicationsAdmin) asserting an enabled toggle with no read-only tooltip and that a changed value reaches onSubmit. Change M2 and S1's Maintainer row to isAdmin false.
